Tho members of the Committee shall be chairmon
of the aub-conmittees of Finance, on Planning and Re-
ception, on Security and Military Mattero, on Civic
Participation, on Labor Participation, on Land Trans-
portation and Route Decorations, on Govoranent Par-
ticipation, on Press and Publicity, on Accommodations
and Tours, on Aircraft Cloarances and Airport Deco-
rations, on Foreign Diplomatio. Farticipation and
Protocol, and on Presidential and Cabinet Zarticipa-
tion, respectively.
The Committee is hereby authorised to call upon
any departmont, bureau, office, agency or instrumen-
tality of the government, including Government-oined
or controlled corporations, for such assistance as
it may need in discharging its duties and functions,
The Chairman of the Committee is horeby autho-
rized to create ad ho connittoes for specific visits
which shall be responsible for the plaming, coordi-
nation and smooth execution of all arrangements in
connection therewith.
IN TIMESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand
and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philip-
pines to be affixed,
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of
April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
(SGD.) FORDINAID B. MARCOS
Fresident of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) RAFADL I. SALAS
Executive Secretary
